item.title: ‘Blade Runner 2099’: Showrunner Silka Luisa Talks Ridley Scott, “Sunshine Noir” & The Future Of Humanity [Bingeworthy Podcast]
item.description: If you’re going to make another “ Blade Runner, ” you better have something interesting to say. The powerful one-two punch of Ridley Scott ’s original movie and Denis Villeneuve ’s “ Blade Runner 2049 ” set an incredibly high bar in terms of visual style and philosophical musings, making it extremely tough for anyone else to step into their shoes. The good news is that the creative force behind Prime Video’ s “ Blade Runner 2099, ” Showrunner and creator Silka Luisa (“ Shining Girls ”), has some ideas of her own, and even some pretty weighty concerns for the fate of humanity as well.
